name: AI Level Builder
description: Type what you want and get a level: a built-in generator plus an AI assistant in the editor.

api-key.name: Claude API key
api-key.description: Needed only for the <cy>Ask AI</c> button. Create one at <cb>console.anthropic.com</c>. It is stored on this device in the mod's settings file and is only ever sent to api.anthropic.com. The offline <cg>Generate</c> button works without it.

model.name: AI model
model.description: Which Claude model the <cy>Ask AI</c> button uses.

effort.name: AI effort
effort.description: How hard the AI thinks. Higher is slower and costs more.

context-objects.name: Objects shown to the AI
context-objects.description: How many of the level's existing objects are sent to the AI so it can see and edit them. More objects cost more per request.
